ValidationRule.description: When the Upsell__c is checked, user must provide complementary information
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
$Profile.Name<>'System Administrator'
&& $Profile.Name<>'Global Delegated Admin'
&& Upsell__c = true
&& ( ISBLANK(Upsell_Comments__c)
|| ISBLANK( Upsell_Annual_Revenue__c )
|| ISBLANK( Upsell_Start_Date__c )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide the following fields : Upsell Annual Revenue, Upsell Comments, Upsell Start Date
